title: Marker on Paper — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Heading band
scenes.purpose: Establish the overhead ruled sheet and the broad marker medium
visuals: Stationary ruled notebook paper with seeded grain
Broad translucent yellow highlighter band swept left to right
Handwritten heading written along the band

beats.development: Wide yellow band draws at marker pace; heading 'an idea becomes a connected system' is written over it
captions: an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: System grows
scenes.purpose: Show the idea becoming a connected system through overlapping translucent ink
visuals: Coral hub fill and red ring around 'idea'
Teal broad-tip rings overlap the links (multiply overlap darkens value)
Labels appear only after each ring closes
Note card drops in, then 'what we have:' and '1 idea' are written

beats.development: Links and node rings draw; cross-links join people–data and tools–flow
Note container completes, then its old value '1 idea' is written

scenes.title: Correction
scenes.purpose: Revise one mark with a visible strike-through and fill the correct value below it
visuals: Sharp red strike-through across '1 idea', old value dims
'5 linked parts!' written below in active red and underlined

beats.development: Strike-through, then correct value written below and underlined
Held clean replacement; full composition settled

findings: Large strokes run at marker pace (0.28–0.5 s each) with staggered overlap to stay brisk within 3 s
Strike-through is the fastest stroke (0.15 s) to read as a sharp revision
justifiedHolds: 1.70–1.86 s pause before correction (style timing rule)
2.66–3.00 s hold on the clean replacement

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration
Demonstrated characteristic action: broad band, strike-through revision, correct value filled below (no extra preview recipes were listed in STYLE.json)
Camera/crop kept fixed so the paper grain stays stationary
